name: symbols
description: List or search code symbols (functions, structs, enums, traits, classes, interfaces, methods) in a file or across the workspace. Parsed with tree-sitter, so a keyword inside a string or comment is not reported as a symbol. Covers Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, C and C++; a file in any other language yields nothing, which means 'not covered', not 'no symbols'.

path.description: File path or directory path relative to workspace root (optional; defaults to entire workspace).

query.description: Symbol name or substring filter (optional; e.g. 'TuiState', 'InputEditor', 'run_turn').
